messages:
oliver: Noticed an odd pattern: traffic from onboarding runners is getting attributed to other projects when X-Redwood-Project header is missing. Dashboard shows unexpected spikes.
sophie: Routing currently falls back to org-default then proxy-owner. That explains it. Might be better to mark as projectless and surface in console.
alejandro: Agree. Quick patch: tag requests with routing_reason and project_id=null when header absent, emit metric requests.projectless.count.
sophie: Add a console filter and banner: 'Some usage is un-attributed. Map keys or set project header.' Product can provide copy.
oliver: Also ask billing: can org-level line items accept project=null? If not, we'll keep billing to org and stop attributing to unrelated projects.
infra-bot: [automated] Created INF-5330: "projectless attribution - telemetry + console UX" assigned to alejandro/sophie.
alejandro: I'll ship middleware flag behind FF and dark-launch traces for 24h.
sophie: I'll mock the banner and filter. oliver: schedule a 9am sync tomorrow to review telemetry.
oliver: Thanks everyone. Keep tickets updated. :thumbsup:
